full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph looks upward at a young child with short, softly curled hair standing outdoors. The camera is very low, almost at ground level, so the child's head rises against a wide pale sky and the body becomes a dark half-length silhouette. The face is nearly frontal but turned a little to the right. A subdued expression and lowered gaze make the child appear calm and inward-looking. A dark collared garment blends into the shadowed lower half, with only a narrow highlight along one shoulder. Fine stems and sparse leaves rise at the left edge, while a dark tree mass enters from the right. Several small dark wing-like shapes are scattered across the bright sky; some are sharp enough to suggest flying birds, and others remain blurred flecks. Their different sizes and focus levels imply depth and motion without establishing a clear count. A soft out-of-focus band of grasses or foliage crosses the very bottom foreground, partly obscuring the clothing. Light comes from the open sky behind and above the child. It silvers the edges of hair and cheek but leaves the face and torso in deep gray shadow. The sky is mottled with soft cloudy tones rather than blank white. Film grain, light scratches, and haze are visible across the picture, giving it an aged tactile surface. The child forms the central vertical anchor, while the sky, plants, and moving marks create a loose ring around the head. No readable words appear. The scene feels both intimate and slightly dreamlike, its unusual low viewpoint turning ordinary outdoor elements into a quiet visual mystery.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白照片从下方仰望一位站在户外、留短卷发的孩子。相机位置很低，几乎贴近地面，所以孩子的头在宽阔浅色天空前升起，身体成为深色半身剪影。脸大致朝前，略向右转。平静的神情和微微垂下的目光让孩子显得安静、内收。深色有领衣服融入下半部阴影，只有一侧肩膀留有狭窄亮边。细茎和稀疏叶片从左缘升起，右边则伸入深色树丛。几个小小的深色、似翼的形状散在明亮天空里；有些轮廓足以让人想到飞鸟，另一些仍是模糊碎影。它们大小与清晰度不同，暗示深度和运动，但无法确定数量。极近的前景有一带失焦草叶横过底部，部分遮住衣服。光来自孩子身后和上方的开阔天空，使头发与脸颊边缘发银，却让脸和躯干处于深灰阴影。天空有柔和斑驳的云调，并非空白纯白。胶片颗粒、细划痕和薄雾遍布画面，赋予陈旧而可触的表面。孩子成为中央竖向支点，天空、植物和飞动小痕迹在头周围形成松散环绕。没有可读文字。场景既亲近又略似梦境，异常低的视点把普通户外元素转化为安静的视觉谜团。
style_prompt_en: Low-angle monochrome photography sets a dark central silhouette against broad, softly mottled sky. Strong backlight gives hair and edges a narrow silver rim while leaving the front planes in deep gray. Sparse stems, irregular tree masses, and small wing-like marks interrupt the surrounding brightness at varied depths. A blurred foreground band frames the lower edge and increases the sense of looking from within the ground cover. Fine grain, faint scratches, and atmospheric haze keep the surface visibly analog and imperfect. The composition is open above and dense below, with a calm vertical center surrounded by loose movement. The mood is intimate, dreamlike, and quietly enigmatic.
style_prompt_zh: 低角度单色摄影把深色中央剪影置于宽阔、柔和斑驳的天空前。强逆光给发丝和边缘留下狭窄银边，使正面平面留在深灰中。稀疏枝茎、不规则树丛和似翼的小痕迹在不同深度打断周围亮部。模糊前景带框住下缘，强化从草丛间向上看的感受。细颗粒、淡划痕与空气雾保持可见的胶片式不完美表面。构图上方开阔、下方密集，安静的竖向中心被松散动势围绕。气氛亲近、如梦而安静难测。
theme_en: A child seen from below beneath a bright sky of moving dark shapes
theme_zh: 从低处仰望明亮天空下的孩子与飞动暗影
name: Emmet Gowin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
